relatives.title: Make Way for Tomorrow
relatives.shares: a household quietly selling and giving up its things as the money runs out

relatives.title: The Full Monty
relatives.shares: men out of work taking humiliating employment and finding company in it

films.title: Variety Lights
films.engine: A shabby touring variety troupe picks up a young woman who pays their fare out of her own pocket, and the ageing man who runs the company drops the woman who has kept him for years to build a new act around the newcomer. She takes what the arrangement gives her and signs with a bigger show the week it is ready; he goes back to the woman he discarded, on a train going the other way, already looking at the next young face across the aisle.

predicaments.situation: a devoted partner is left for a newcomer
predicaments.basis: The morning after the dinner at the wealthy man's mansion, Checco walks to the station beside Liliana and leaves his mistress Melina to follow behind with the rest of the troupe.

predicaments.situation: a helper is left behind after being used
predicaments.basis: Checco begs Melina for the money to launch his own show and takes it triumphantly as she orders him never to contact her again — then Liliana, whose act he has built, tells him she has signed with a competitor and he collapses.

predicaments.situation: an aging person pursues someone far younger
predicaments.basis: The ageing head of the troupe realises at the mansion that he wants the young woman who boarded the train after the show, and in the last shot, back with Melina, he begins flirting with another young woman across the aisle.

predicaments.situation: a newcomer eclipses the ones already there
predicaments.basis: A hostile crowd mocks every performer until the promoter interrupts the show to feature Liliana, and she ends the film in a fur coat in a first-class carriage while the troupe rides to Foggia.

relatives.title: All About Eve
relatives.shares: a newcomer taken in by a company eclipses the people who took her in

relatives.title: The Blue Angel
relatives.shares: an older man wrecks the life he had over a young woman performing on a small stage

relatives.title: A Star Is Born (1954)
relatives.shares: one career rises exactly as the career that lifted it collapses

relatives.title: Sawdust and Tinsel
relatives.shares: a travelling showman humiliates himself, then returns to the woman he abandoned because no one else will have him

films.title: Sword of Penitence
films.engine: A man leaves prison intending to live honestly, and every time he nearly manages it someone else's crime or his own record puts him back where he began: his brother presses stolen goods into his hand on the road, a constable tells his employer what he used to be, and he is dismissed. The film turns on whether other people will permit a man to become someone new — and it answers that even mercy from a stranger cannot stop the last night ending in a killing.

predicaments.situation: a change of heart is not believed
predicaments.basis: Sakichi works diligently for a rice-merchant and earns his trust until the constable Manabe reveals his prison record and he is dismissed; he tells his brother that society will never accept that a conversion is genuine.

predicaments.situation: blame falls on the wrong person
predicaments.basis: Fleeing with the hair ornament he has stolen from Oyae, Ishimatsu presses it into Sakichi's hand on the road and runs, leaving his brother holding it when the constable arrives.

predicaments.situation: a helper is left behind after being used
predicaments.basis: Sakichi hides the burglar Genshichi from the officers and urges him to give up crime; Genshichi laughs at him, disappears, and later comes back to demand a share of Sakichi's money and beats Ishimatsu near to death.

predicaments.situation: a theft is answered with a gift
predicaments.basis: Sleepwalking in the house where he is being hidden, Sakichi raids the cash-box; Oyae's father refuses to call him a thief and gives him more money to start again elsewhere.

predicaments.situation: saving a life creates a lasting bond
predicaments.basis: Oyae clears Sakichi in front of the constable and later conceals him at her father's premises; when Genshichi kidnaps her, Sakichi kills him and returns her to her father.

relatives.title: Les Misérables
relatives.shares: a released convict is refused a new life by everyone who learns what he was, and a theft is answered with a gift instead of an accusation

relatives.title: I Am a Fugitive from a Chain Gang
relatives.shares: honest work is destroyed the moment the record is produced

relatives.title: Angels with Dirty Faces
relatives.shares: an old associate keeps pulling a man back toward the life he is trying to leave

relatives.title: Pickpocket
relatives.shares: a thief's turning is possible only through someone who declines to condemn him

relatives.title: A Prophet
relatives.shares: the choice at the end is between dying and going back to crime, with nothing else offered

films.title: Rich and Strange
films.engine: A bored London clerk is handed his inheritance early and takes his wife around the world on it; on the boat each of them finds someone more interesting than their marriage, and both of those someones turn out to want something. They nearly drown together in an abandoned steamer, get home, and within minutes are arguing about whether to move flat.

predicaments.situation: a sudden fortune unsettles an ordinary life
predicaments.basis: A letter offers Fred and Em as much of a wealthy uncle's money as they want, now rather than after his death; Fred quits his job and the voyage it pays for takes their marriage apart.

predicaments.situation: a devoted partner is left for a newcomer
predicaments.basis: Em falls in love with Commodore Gordon while Fred is seasick below, then Fred attaches himself to a German princess, and by Singapore the two spend no time with each other at all.

roles.leaving: Fred and Em, each in turn
roles.left: Fred and Em, each in turn

predicaments.situation: someone is courted for their money
predicaments.basis: Gordon tells Em that Fred's princess is an adventuress who will stay only until his money runs out; by the time Em reaches him the woman has left for Rangoon with £1000.

predicaments.situation: one betrayer returns to save the other
predicaments.basis: Em walks out on Gordon on the way to Kuala Lumpur in order to warn Fred that he is being fleeced, and arrives too late to stop it.

predicaments.situation: shared danger returns two people to each other
predicaments.basis: Trapped in their cabin as the collided tramp steamer floods and the crew abandon ship, Fred and Em prepare to die together, escape through a porthole in the morning, and are taken aboard a passing junk.

predicaments.situation: a reconciliation returns to the old quarrel
predicaments.basis: Home in England after nearly drowning, seeing a birth and being fed their own cat, the couple look happy and are immediately bickering about whether to stay in the flat.

relatives.title: Voyage to Italy
relatives.shares: a marriage comes apart on a journey abroad and is jolted back together by a shock neither of them chose

relatives.title: Two for the Road
relatives.shares: travel money exposes what the marriage was actually like

relatives.title: The Awful Truth
relatives.shares: both partners stray in parallel and return to each other with nothing settled

relatives.title: Force Majeure
relatives.shares: a brush with death rearranges a couple and then leaves them exactly where they were

relatives.title: Le Bonheur
relatives.shares: an ordinary domestic life is unsettled by an outside attachment taken lightly

films.title: War and Peace
films.engine: An awkward heir and a soldier friend both love the same young woman across seven years of invasion: one is made to wait a year for her, and cannot forgive her when she does not wait; the other spends the whole time telling her she is blameless while wanting her himself. War burns the houses and kills the sons, and what is left standing at the end is the two people who were never supposed to end up together.

predicaments.situation: a sudden fortune unsettles an ordinary life
predicaments.basis: Old Count Bezukhov dies having declared his illegitimate son Pierre legitimate and sole heir, and the relatives who snubbed him at the mansion turn to hypocritical concern overnight.

predicaments.situation: someone is courted for their money
predicaments.basis: Hélène Kuragina sets her sights on Pierre the moment he inherits and her father Prince Vasily installs himself as administrator of the estates; the marriage ends after Pierre's duel with Dolokhov.

predicaments.situation: lovers are not permitted to belong together
predicaments.basis: Prince Nicholas Bolkonsky makes Andrei wait a year before marrying Natasha, on the grounds that she is too young and the Rostovs are not their social equals, and Andrei leaves for Prussia on that promise.

predicaments.situation: a promise to wait is broken by another
predicaments.basis: While Andrei is away, the secretly married Anatole Kuragin persuades Natasha to elope; Sonya and Pierre stop the plan but not the gossip, and Andrei ends the engagement.

predicaments.situation: forgiveness is refused to the one asking
predicaments.basis: Natasha begs Pierre to carry her regret to Andrei, who says on the eve of Borodino that he cannot forgive her; they meet again only when she finds him among the wounded in her family's care and he dies at the monastery.

predicaments.situation: a friend loves the one they speak for
predicaments.basis: Pierre threatens Anatole to protect Natasha's name, urges Andrei at the front to forgive her, and assures her she is blameless while telling her that if he were free he would ask for her hand.

relatives.title: Cyrano de Bergerac
relatives.shares: a man pleads another man's case to the woman he himself loves

relatives.title: The Age of Innocence
relatives.shares: a marriage is arranged and a love forbidden by what the family considers equal

relatives.title: Doctor Zhivago
relatives.shares: a love is repeatedly pulled apart by an invasion that redraws everyone's life

relatives.title: Gone with the Wind
relatives.shares: a young woman's suitors are decided by a war that burns the family house down

relatives.title: The Leopard
relatives.shares: an old family order dissolves while its members go on arranging marriages inside it

films.title: Without Pity
films.engine: A woman stops a train so a wounded stranger can be treated, and the two of them spend the rest of the film trying to buy their way out of a country that will not let them be together. Every route out runs through the man who profits from her having nowhere to go: he houses her, tells the soldier she will end up on the street, and takes the money back at the end over her body.

predicaments.situation: saving a life creates a lasting bond
predicaments.basis: Angela has the train stopped so that Jerry, shot and thrown onto her boxcar, can be treated; when he recovers he seeks her out to thank her and promises to come back for her.

predicaments.situation: lovers are not permitted to belong together
predicaments.basis: An Italian woman held in a refugee convent and a Black American sergeant in the occupation army can only be together by leaving, and everything that would let them leave belongs to Pier Luigi.

predicaments.situation: the only available help comes from an exploiter
predicaments.basis: Pier Luigi shelters and moves Angela while telling Jerry he cannot keep supporting her and that she will fall into prostitution, then refuses her outright when she asks for help escaping.

predicaments.situation: someone sells themselves to keep another safe
predicaments.basis: Jerry, who has steadily refused to act as intermediary for the smugglers, agrees to transport the goods the morning after Pier Luigi's warning about Angela, and is arrested at once.

predicaments.situation: someone searches for a missing relative
predicaments.basis: Angela's journey to Livorno is a search for her brother Carlo; when Pier Luigi tells her at the docks that Carlo is dead she throws herself into the river.

predicaments.situation: an escape is paid for with a life
predicaments.basis: Jerry holds Pier Luigi and Giacomo at gunpoint and takes their truck to get the smuggling money for their passage; Angela is shot outside the cathedral, the money is repossessed, and Jerry drives off the cliff with her body.

relatives.title: Bitter Rice
relatives.shares: postwar want puts a woman inside a racket she cannot get out of alive

relatives.title: They Live by Night
relatives.shares: two people rob the people around them to buy an escape that is never going to be sold to them

relatives.title: Le Quai des brumes
relatives.shares: a soldier and a girl try to leave a port town owned by the man who controls her

relatives.title: Paisan
relatives.shares: an occupation-era encounter between an American soldier and an Italian woman with no shared ground to stand on

relatives.title: Gun Crazy
relatives.shares: a couple's flight ends with one of them dead and the other driving into the wreck deliberately

films.title: Difficult Years
films.engine: A small-town clerk is told by his superior that he must join the ruling party or lose the job that feeds his family, so he signs — and backdates the signature — while still drinking with the friends who despise the party. Twenty years later, when the tide turns, the same superior sits down with the new authorities and dismisses him for having been a member. The film is about a man with no convictions being made to carry, and then to pay for, everyone else's.

predicaments.situation: a man joins what he despises to survive
predicaments.basis: Aldo Piscitello, a municipal employee, is forced by his boss to enroll in the Fascist Party on pain of losing his job, and backdates his membership to 1921 to look sincere.

predicaments.situation: yesterday's obedience becomes today's crime
predicaments.basis: The same act of enrollment that kept Aldo employed for twenty years is the sole ground on which he is sacked once the war ends.

predicaments.situation: the guilty pin their blame on the powerless
predicaments.basis: Former Fascists all around him declare themselves anti-Fascists, and his boss — the man who forced him to join — sits with an American officer and fires him for his membership.

roles.blaming: the boss and the reinvented Fascists

predicaments.situation: the young are spent for their elders' politics
predicaments.basis: Giovanni comes home from military service hoping for an ordinary married life, is called back when Italy enters the war, and is killed by a unit of fleeing German soldiers while on furlough as the fighting reaches Sicily.

relatives.title: Mephisto
relatives.shares: a man signs on with a regime he does not believe in so that he can keep working

relatives.title: The Nasty Girl
relatives.shares: those who served the regime prosper after it falls while the one left holding the record is cast out

relatives.title: The Conformist
relatives.shares: an unremarkable man attaches himself to power to be left alone, and is defined forever by the attachment

relatives.title: The Marriage of Maria Braun
relatives.shares: the end of a war rearranges who counts as guilty, and the rearrangement is done by the people who profited most

films.title: Downhill
films.engine: A schoolboy lets himself be expelled for getting a shopgirl pregnant, knowing his friend did it and cannot afford the disgrace, and promises never to say so. His father believes the charge, so the boy leaves home and goes down through waiting tables, a marriage that empties the money he inherits, and paid dancing in Paris, until the truth finally reaches home behind him.

predicaments.situation: a man is condemned for another's crime
predicaments.basis: Roddy Berwick accepts expulsion for Mabel's pregnancy so that Tim Wakeley, the actual father, can keep the scholarship he needs for Oxford.

predicaments.situation: a father refuses to believe his own child
predicaments.basis: Sir Thomas Berwick takes the shopgirl's accusation as fact, and Roddy leaves the house rather than argue.

predicaments.situation: affection lasts exactly as long as the money
predicaments.basis: The actress Julia marries Roddy once he inherits £30,000, keeps up her affair with Archie throughout, and discards him after the inheritance and the mansion are gone.

predicaments.situation: the truth arrives after the damage is done
predicaments.basis: Roddy's father learns the truth about the accusation only after the years of ruin, and greets his broken son by begging forgiveness.

predicaments.situation: an exile is taken back by his own
predicaments.basis: Sailors ship the delirious Roddy home from Marseille and he ends up back at school playing in Old Boy matches, in the place he held at the start.

relatives.title: The Winslow Boy
relatives.shares: a boy's expulsion on an accusation the household must decide whether to believe

relatives.title: In the Name of the Father
relatives.shares: a man serves the punishment for what someone else did, and the record is corrected only long after

relatives.title: Nights of Cabiria
relatives.shares: someone is loved precisely as long as their money lasts and is left when it is gone

relatives.title: Sansho the Bailiff
relatives.shares: a fall through servitude and degradation ending in a return to the place one came from

films.title: The Manxman
films.engine: A poor fisherman, refused permission to marry, goes abroad to make money and asks his educated friend to look after the girl while he is gone; the friend and the girl fall in love. Word comes that the fisherman is dead, then that he is not, and the friend — his career about to give him the island's highest judicial seat — tells the girl to keep her promise and marry the other man. She does, bears the friend's child, and the fisherman raises it as his own, until the day the friend has to judge her in open court.

predicaments.situation: a friend is entrusted with what he wants
predicaments.basis: Pete asks Philip to plead his marriage case to Kate's father and then to take care of Kate while he is in Africa; Philip, who loves her too, calls on her daily and they begin an affair at the old mill.

predicaments.situation: a man reported dead comes back alive
predicaments.basis: News reaches the village that Pete was killed in Africa, and Kate and Philip begin planning a life together before a telegram reveals another man's body was misidentified.

predicaments.situation: ambition is chosen over the person one loves
predicaments.basis: Philip, about to be made Deemster, urges Kate to keep her promise and marry Pete, and later refuses to run off with her from his law offices rather than lose the appointment.

predicaments.situation: a child is raised by another's hand
predicaments.basis: Pete believes the daughter Kate bears is his and cares for her devotedly through Kate's absence, and refuses to give her up when Kate tells him he is not the father.

predicaments.situation: a lie is told to protect someone's name
predicaments.basis: After Kate walks out leaving a note and the baby, Pete puts on a brave face and tells the village she has gone to London for a short rest.

predicaments.situation: a private life is exposed to public judgement
predicaments.basis: Kate's suicide attempt brings her to trial on Philip's first day on the bench, where he removes his wig and confesses the affair, and the villagers watch through the windows and jeer as the two leave with the child.

relatives.title: Cyrano de Bergerac
relatives.shares: a man is sent to plead another's love and loves her himself while pleading

relatives.title: The Scarlet Letter
relatives.shares: a woman carries the visible consequence in public while the man keeps his standing and his office

relatives.title: Ugetsu
relatives.shares: a man goes away to make his fortune and returns to a marriage that cannot survive what happened in his absence

relatives.title: The Return of Martin Guerre
relatives.shares: a man's return from the dead forces a household to confront who the child belongs to

relatives.title: Jules and Jim
relatives.shares: two lifelong friends and one woman, with the friendship holding until the child settles the question

films.title: Jolanda, the Daughter of the Black Corsair
films.engine: A woman brought up among travellers by the man who was supposed to kill her, raised to fight and to pass for a young man, is told at his deathbed whose daughter she is and who had her father murdered. She spends the film taking that back — including kidnapping the killer's daughter, who has fallen in love with her believing her a man, and offering her in trade for the prisoners her enemy holds.

predicaments.situation: a child sets out to avenge a parent
predicaments.basis: Dying, the guardian tells Jolly that she is Jolanda of Ventimiglia and that Van Guld, Count of Medina, had her father treacherously murdered; she allies with the pirate Morgan to answer it.

predicaments.situation: a child is raised by another's hand
predicaments.basis: Handed over at the age of two to a man charged with killing her, Jolanda is instead brought up among gypsies and trained in arms, knowing nothing of her name or family.

predicaments.situation: someone is loved under a mistaken identity
predicaments.basis: Consuelo, daughter of the Count of Medina, has been in love with Jolanda since their first meeting, deceived by her masculine bearing — which is what lets Jolanda walk into the palace and take her.

predicaments.situation: an agreement is honoured by one side only
predicaments.basis: Van Guld tricks the English representative into consenting to arrest the pirates at the moment the armistice is signed, and then sets an ambush at the very site of the agreed exchange.

predicaments.situation: a captive is traded for another's freedom
predicaments.basis: Jolanda kidnaps Consuelo to exchange her for Ralf and the other arrested pirates.

relatives.title: Lady Snowblood
relatives.shares: a child raised and trained by a guardian for the single purpose of answering a parent's murder

relatives.title: The Bad Sleep Well
relatives.shares: a child works from inside the killer's household to answer a father's death

relatives.title: True Grit
relatives.shares: a young woman takes on hired fighting men to see her father's killer answered for

relatives.title: Sylvia Scarlett
relatives.shares: a woman living as a young man is loved by another woman who does not know

films.title: Two Men in Manhattan
films.engine: A wire-service reporter sent to find out why a diplomat missed a session goes hunting through the man's mistresses with a tabloid photographer, and they find him dead in an actress's apartment. The rest is a fight between the two of them over what happens to the picture — one wants the widow told gently, the other has already moved the body for a better shot and means to photograph the wife's face as she hears.

predicaments.situation: a lie is told to protect someone's name
predicaments.basis: Rouvier explains that Fèvre-Berthier was a hero of the Resistance and that his death in his mistress's apartment will not be reported; the three men carry the body to a car and leave it to be found there.

predicaments.situation: one man's ruin is another man's living
predicaments.basis: Delmas rearranges the corpse on the bed for a more saleable photograph, hands over a decoy roll of film, and plans to shoot the widow's face at the instant she is told.

predicaments.situation: a family is kept ignorant to spare them
predicaments.basis: Anne knows about her father's affair with Judith and says her mother does not; she sends her mother out of the room before Moreau can speak.

predicaments.situation: a private life is exposed to public judgement
predicaments.basis: The photographs that would put the diplomat's mistress in every paper end up pushed through a storm drain by the man who took them.

predicaments.situation: a child searches for a parent gone missing
predicaments.basis: Anne has been following Moreau since he left the UN information office, hoping he would lead her to her father.

relatives.title: Ace in the Hole
relatives.shares: a newsman's living made directly out of another person's disaster, and the disaster prolonged to keep the story

relatives.title: La Dolce Vita
relatives.shares: a reporter and a photographer working a death and the family it belongs to, one wanting the picture and one no longer sure

relatives.title: Nightcrawler
relatives.shares: a body moved to improve the shot

relatives.title: Sweet Smell of Success
relatives.shares: two men bound by work, one of whom will print anything, and the other's slow discovery of what he is party to

films.title: The Last Days of Pompeii
films.engine: A soldier comes home to find his father murdered and the house looted by a hooded band that leaves a cross painted on the wall, and vows to answer it. The band turns out to be run by the city's own priesthood and its consul's mistress, funding a revolt — and they hang the killings on the Christians, whom the blind slave girl and the woman he loves both belong to.

predicaments.situation: a child sets out to avenge a parent
predicaments.basis: Glaucus returns to Pompeii to find his father murdered and his house looted by the hooded men, and vows revenge on the killers.

predicaments.situation: the guilty pin their blame on the powerless
predicaments.basis: Arbaces, high priest of Isis, carves a cross into Marcus's body, and Gallinus rounds up the Christians and has them tortured and condemned for the crime wave his own masters are committing.

predicaments.situation: a man is condemned for another's crime
predicaments.basis: Julia stabs the consul Ascanius after confessing the conspiracy to him and names Glaucus as the killer; he is imprisoned and thrown to the arena.

predicaments.situation: a secret is confided to the wrong person
predicaments.basis: Nydia, thinking she is speaking to Antonius after the funeral, gives directions to a secret Christian gathering to Gallinus, who is in charge of persecuting them.

predicaments.situation: a woman's faith puts her against her family
predicaments.basis: Ione, the consul's daughter, converts and is imprisoned when she tries to speak for Glaucus, while her father is in league with the men persecuting her fellow believers.

relatives.title: Day of Wrath
relatives.shares: a community's rulers explain their own crimes by burning the people least able to answer back

relatives.title: The Ox-Bow Incident
relatives.shares: the wrong men condemned quickly because someone needed a crime accounted for

relatives.title: The Bad Sleep Well
relatives.shares: a man discovers the murder of his father leads back to the men who govern

relatives.title: Sanjuro
relatives.shares: an outsider learns the officials leading the hunt for the conspirators are the conspiracy

films.title: A Mother Should be Loved
films.engine: A father dies and leaves behind a woman raising two boys, one of whom is not hers; the arrangement holds only as long as the older boy does not know. When he finds out, he cannot stop testing her — reading every kindness she shows him as an over-correction that cheats his brother — and he keeps refusing what she offers until the family can be reassembled on terms he believes.

predicaments.situation: a child is raised as another woman's own
predicaments.basis: Chieko is Kajiwara's second wife and Sadao is his son by the first, and after the funeral the family friend Okazuki asks her to go on raising Sadao as hers.

predicaments.situation: a hidden origin comes to light
predicaments.basis: Preparing his university application, Sadao consults his birth certificate and learns Chieko is not his mother.

predicaments.situation: a parent's love is not evenly divided
predicaments.basis: Sadao repeatedly accuses Chieko of favouring him over her own son Kosaku, and forces the money she lent him back to Kosaku to pay for the trip she made him cancel.

predicaments.situation: a debt is taken on for a friend
predicaments.basis: Sadao borrows money from Chieko to clear his rowing teammate Hattori's debts and get him out of the whorehouse he has been living in.

predicaments.situation: a stranger's word succeeds where a parent's fails
predicaments.basis: Chieko finds Sadao at the whorehouse and begs him to come home and he refuses, but a cleaner speaks to him after she has gone and he returns.

relatives.title: Like Father, Like Son
relatives.shares: a child raised by people who are not his blood, and the day the papers say so

relatives.title: Secrets & Lies
relatives.shares: a parentage kept hidden for years and the reckoning when it surfaces

relatives.title: East of Eden
relatives.shares: a son convinced a parent's love is unevenly split and testing it to destruction

relatives.title: The Kid with a Bike
relatives.shares: a boy who runs from the household that wants him and is turned back by an outsider

relatives.title: Stella Dallas
relatives.shares: a mother whose love is expressed by relinquishing her claim on the child

films.title: Passing Fancy
films.engine: A widowed day-labourer takes in a homeless young woman and lets himself believe she might have him, while everyone around them quietly assumes she belongs with his younger workmate. When his small son nearly dies and there is no money for the doctor, the men compete to be the one who pays for it with his own future — and the father wins the contest only to discover he cannot bear the exile he insisted on.

predicaments.situation: affection is returned as kinship instead of love
predicaments.basis: Kihachi grooms himself for Harue, who tells him she thinks of him as a kind uncle, while Otome asks him to talk the younger Jiro into marrying her.

predicaments.situation: a debt is taken on for a friend
predicaments.basis: Kihachi cannot pay the doctor treating his son Tomio's enteritis, so Jiro stops Harue from raising the money and borrows it from his barber friend instead.

predicaments.situation: one takes another's place at great cost
predicaments.basis: Jiro plans to work off the loan as a labourer in Hokkaido, so Kihachi knocks him unconscious to make him miss the ship and sails in his stead.

predicaments.situation: a parent leaves the child to find work
predicaments.basis: Kihachi leaves Tomio with Otome and the barber and boards the ship for Hokkaido, then jumps overboard out of homesickness and swims back.

relatives.title: City Lights
relatives.shares: a man who ruins himself for someone whose feeling for him was never what he thought

relatives.title: The Kid
relatives.shares: a poor man and the small son who is the only thing he cannot trade away

relatives.title: Bicycle Thieves
relatives.shares: a father whose plans collapse in front of his child and who is forgiven anyway

relatives.title: Umberto D.
relatives.shares: an old man with nothing to offer discovering what he is unwilling to leave

relatives.title: Marty
relatives.shares: a plain man told, gently and by everyone, that the woman is not for him

films.title: The Battle of the River Plate
films.engine: Three lighter warships corner a stronger one and decide that closing to knife range is safer than keeping their distance; the damage runs both ways and the stronger ship limps into a neutral harbour where the clock, not the guns, becomes the weapon. What settles it is a lie — reinforcements reported that do not exist — and a commander who, believing himself trapped, chooses to destroy his ship rather than spend his crew, and is saluted by the men who tricked him.

predicaments.situation: the weaker party attacks instead of withdrawing
predicaments.basis: The three British cruisers close swiftly on the Admiral Graf Spee to nullify her longer gun range and split her fire by attacking from different directions.

predicaments.situation: a rumour is planted to move an enemy
predicaments.basis: With their real reinforcements still far away, the British reverse their demand and let local media spread false reports of battleships and carriers waiting outside Montevideo.

predicaments.situation: a leader ends the fight to save lives
predicaments.basis: Langsdorff takes the ship out with a skeleton crew and scuttles her in the River Plate rather than fight a battle he believes he cannot survive.

predicaments.situation: an enemy is honoured for his restraint
predicaments.basis: The Royal Navy signals that many lives have been saved, and Langsdorff is personally complimented by the British for his decision.

relatives.title: The Enemy Below
relatives.shares: two commanders hunting each other into something close to regard

relatives.title: Das Boot
relatives.shares: a captain whose real charge is the men in the hull, not the mission

relatives.title: The Man Who Never Was
relatives.shares: a war decided by a planted falsehood the enemy believes

relatives.title: Letters from Iwo Jima
relatives.shares: a commander choosing the survival of his men over the expected end

relatives.title: Master and Commander: The Far Side of the World
relatives.shares: an outmatched ship winning by closing the range instead of running

films.title: The Law Is the Law
films.engine: A customs man and a smuggler in a village cut in two by a border have spent years in a game each needs the other to keep playing. Then a scrap of old paperwork proves the officer was born on the wrong side of the line, and the state he served unmakes him piece by piece — nationality, marriage, son, the ground under his feet — until the only person who will help him is the man he has spent his life arresting.

predicaments.situation: a hidden origin comes to light
predicaments.basis: Giuseppe discovers Ferdinand was born in the kitchen of the Two Borders Hotel, on what is marked as the Italian side, and that the innkeeper Donnadiè registered the birth with the French townhall only because it was a shorter walk in the rain.

predicaments.situation: a man is declared to belong nowhere
predicaments.basis: Ferdinand loses his French nationality, is jailed by the Italians as a deserter, then loses his right to Italian citizenship too, and is turned back at the border as undocumented.

predicaments.situation: an adversary becomes the only available ally
predicaments.basis: Ferdinand asks the smuggler he has hunted for years to take him across and sort out his papers, and Giuseppe keeps helping him, even feeding him on the mountain.

predicaments.situation: a friend is mistaken for a betrayer
predicaments.basis: Seeing Giuseppe arrive with the police and gendarmes who are bringing him the good news, Ferdinand fires on him from his sniper nest.

predicaments.situation: one man's small lie undoes another's life
predicaments.basis: Donnadiè had redrawn the border on his hotel's frontage to attract tourists, which is why the kitchen where Ferdinand was born appeared to be in Italy.

relatives.title: Brazil
relatives.shares: a life dismantled by a clerical slip that nobody can be made to unmake

relatives.title: The Captain from Köpenick
relatives.shares: a man who exists or does not exist depending on which paper is stamped

relatives.title: The Terminal
relatives.shares: someone stranded in the gap between two states, belonging to neither

relatives.title: Catch Me If You Can
relatives.shares: a hunter and his quarry who end up needing each other more than the chase

relatives.title: Green Card
relatives.shares: a marriage and a nationality made contingent on where a document says you were

films.title: Beyond the Forest
films.engine: A small-town doctor's wife has decided her real life is happening somewhere else and that the man she is sleeping with is the door to it. Every time she reaches for that life it withdraws — he stalls, then wants her, then wants to wait — and she keeps clearing obstacles with escalating violence: a witness who threatens to talk, then the pregnancy itself, then her own body.

predicaments.situation: a spouse wants a life the marriage forbids
predicaments.basis: Rosa is bored by Lewis's small Wisconsin practice and his patients who pay in produce, and takes the money owed him to finance a trip to Chicago.

predicaments.situation: a lover withdraws once the promise comes due
predicaments.basis: Latimer avoids Rosa in Chicago and tells her he intends to marry someone else; later he wants her again, then asks to wait a month or so after Moose's death.

predicaments.situation: a threat to tell is answered with killing
predicaments.basis: Moose overhears the divorce plans and warns Rosa that if she does not tell Latimer about the pregnancy he will, so she shoots him on the hunt and claims she took him for a deer.

predicaments.situation: a child is wanted by one parent only
predicaments.basis: Lewis tells Rosa he cares about nothing but the baby and she may leave once it is born; she throws herself down an embankment to end the pregnancy.

predicaments.situation: a wronged spouse forgives too readily
predicaments.basis: Lewis takes Rosa back after Chicago, and after she confesses both the affair and the murder he sets no condition beyond the birth of the child.

relatives.title: Madame Bovary
relatives.shares: a provincial wife who spends everything, including other people, reaching for an imagined life

relatives.title: Double Indemnity
relatives.shares: a lover who cools exactly when the killing has been done for his sake

relatives.title: Leave Her to Heaven
relatives.shares: a woman who removes the people and pregnancies standing between her and the man she wants

relatives.title: The Postman Always Rings Twice
relatives.shares: a wife trapped in a small life who kills her way toward a bigger one

relatives.title: Written on the Wind
relatives.shares: an unwanted pregnancy turned into a weapon inside a marriage nobody will leave

films.title: Girls of the Night
films.engine: A woman released from a reformatory tries three times to build an ordinary working life, and each time her past arrives ahead of her: an employer who turns cold, co-workers who want her back in the trade, an old handler at her door. When she finally has work she loves and a man who wants to marry her, his family and her employers close ranks against the match, and she chooses to remove herself rather than let him pay for her.

predicaments.situation: someone is despised once their past is known
predicaments.basis: Mrs. Takagi is happy with Kuniko's work as a maid until she learns she was a prostitute, after which she treats her with contempt.

predicaments.situation: old work reclaims someone trying to leave it
predicaments.basis: Her factory colleague Kimiko sets up a meeting with three customers and has her beaten when she drives them off, and later her former pimp turns up in her flat to recruit her back.

predicaments.situation: elders forbid a marriage
predicaments.basis: Tsukasa's mother writes that she will not allow her son to marry a woman with Kuniko's history, and the Shimas, who are related to his family, tell Kuniko they see no possibility either.

predicaments.situation: someone withdraws rather than cost another his family
predicaments.basis: Tsukasa returns saying he will marry her even if he is disowned, but Kuniko has already vanished, leaving a letter of thanks and going to work as an ama in Bōsō.

relatives.title: Mamma Roma
relatives.shares: a woman who has left the trade and finds it will not let her have an ordinary life

relatives.title: Nights of Cabiria
relatives.shares: repeated attempts at a decent life, each one broken by the world's memory of her

relatives.title: Waterloo Bridge
relatives.shares: a woman who disappears rather than let a man marry down into her past

relatives.title: Ali: Fear Eats the Soul
relatives.shares: a couple whose families and neighbours make an unacceptable match unlivable

relatives.title: Sonata... The Scarlet Letter
relatives.shares: a community that keeps a woman's old offence permanently visible to everyone who employs her

films.title: Women of the Night
films.engine: Three women left without men or money after a war each end up selling themselves, and the film follows how the first one's ruin drags in the second and the third. What holds it together is that the person who wrecks each of them is never a stranger — it is a sister, an in-law, a lover who said he would provide — and the last movement is one ruined woman trying to pull the youngest back out before the same thing closes over her.

predicaments.situation: survival requires selling what should not be sold
predicaments.basis: Fusako, widowed with an infant she cannot afford to vaccinate, first refuses the shopkeeper's suggestion of prostitution and ends up on the street anyway once her keeper leaves her; Kumiko takes the same road after being robbed of everything.

predicaments.situation: love is feigned to get something else
predicaments.basis: Kuriyama hires Fusako as a secretary and tells her he truly cares for her, but wants a mistress and a place to hide smuggled opium, and is running the same line on her sister at the dance hall.

predicaments.situation: one lover is set aside for another
predicaments.basis: Kuriyama keeps Fusako until he takes an interest in her repatriated sister Natsuko, and it is that displacement, not poverty alone, that sends Fusako into the brothels.

predicaments.situation: help is withheld by those closest
predicaments.basis: Fusako's brother-in-law supports the household but calls the baby's vaccinations unnecessary and overpriced and will not pay; the child dies of illness.

predicaments.situation: revenge on the guilty destroys the avenger
predicaments.basis: Fusako declares she will infect the men of Japan with syphilis, then watches the same disease kill her sister's baby, and cannot answer the clinician who asks whether the revenge has worked.

predicaments.situation: the weakest is hounded by the rest
predicaments.basis: Kumiko, the teenage newcomer, is beaten by a rival group of prostitutes for soliciting on their turf in the ruins of a bombed church, and Fusako is beaten in turn for telling her to quit.

relatives.title: Nights of Cabiria
relatives.shares: a woman selling herself is undone not by the street but by the man who promised to take her off it

relatives.title: Vivre sa vie
relatives.shares: survival requires selling what should not be sold, step by ordinary step

relatives.title: Rosetta
relatives.shares: a young woman with no margin does something unforgivable to another to secure her own place

relatives.title: Mamma Roma
relatives.shares: one woman tries to pull a younger one clear of the life she herself was forced into

relatives.title: Bicycle Thieves
relatives.shares: decency is a luxury the postwar wreckage prices out of reach

films.title: The Human Condition II: Road to Eternity
films.engine: A man who once lost his safety by protecting prisoners is put in uniform under suspicion, and spends the film trying to behave decently inside an institution that punishes decency and rewards cruelty. Every attempt he makes to shield somebody costs him — he takes the beatings meant for his men, fails to save the one soldier being tormented to death, and by the end has killed with his own hands to stay alive, and knows what that makes him.

predicaments.situation: a man tries to stay decent inside cruelty
predicaments.basis: Kaji, conscripted and marked as a leftist, keeps perfect discipline and marksmanship while refusing the brutality the Kwantung Army runs on, and ends the film shouting that he is a monster who intends to survive anyway.

predicaments.situation: the weakest is hounded by the rest
predicaments.basis: Obara, poor-sighted and physically weak, is punished and humiliated without pause by PFC Yoshida and the other soldiers until he kills himself.

predicaments.situation: shielding the weak brings punishment upon the protector
predicaments.basis: Kaji demands discipline for Obara's tormentors, takes his recruits' punishments himself, and is beaten repeatedly by the veteran artillerymen for it.

predicaments.situation: one man lets another die within reach
predicaments.basis: Trapped in quicksand alongside Yoshida during the pursuit of the deserter Shinjo, Kaji refuses to pull him out and seals the fate of the man who drove Obara to suicide.

predicaments.situation: surviving requires becoming the thing one hated
predicaments.basis: To keep the Soviets from finding his position, Kaji strangles a maddened Japanese soldier with his bare hands, then names himself a monster and runs on looking for survivors.

relatives.title: Paths of Glory
relatives.shares: a man of conscience inside an army finds that the institution punishes him, not the cruelty

relatives.title: Full Metal Jacket
relatives.shares: the weakest recruit is hounded by the rest until he breaks completely

relatives.title: Come and See
relatives.shares: surviving a war means becoming something the survivor cannot look at

relatives.title: The Ascent
relatives.shares: two men under the same pressure, and only decency decides which one is unrecognisable at the end

relatives.title: Beau Travail
relatives.shares: a soldier is quietly destroyed by the men whose duty is to keep him

films.title: Era lui... sì! sì!
films.engine: A department store owner keeps dreaming that a young man appears at the last moment and takes the woman he was about to win — and then that exact young man walks in looking for a job. The film is about a man punishing a stranger for something the stranger has not done and cannot know about, and about how much of an innocent's life can be lifted up and thrown down by someone else's private fear.

predicaments.situation: someone is mistaken for a feared rival
predicaments.basis: Fernando recognises shy young Walter as the face from his recurring dreams, and treats him from then on as the thief who steals women from under his nose, eventually trying to kill him.

predicaments.situation: someone is exalted then discarded without explanation
predicaments.basis: Walter is hired, made general manager within two days, then attacked and cast out, then courted again, never told why any of it is happening, and finally tries to run away exhausted.

predicaments.situation: a parent's hostility ends a child's romance
predicaments.basis: Grazia, who fell for Walter at first sight while hiding that his boss is her father, drops him when she sees how her father behaves toward him, leaving Walter in despair.

predicaments.situation: a wrongdoer must beg forgiveness of his victim
predicaments.basis: Therapy reveals the dreams come from a wrong Fernando himself did to Walter, and the only cure is to give the young man his position back and ask his pardon.

relatives.title: Being There
relatives.shares: a blank newcomer is raised to a height purely by what other people project onto him

relatives.title: Kagemusha
relatives.shares: a man is treated entirely as the person he resembles, and dropped when the resemblance stops being useful

relatives.title: The Servant
relatives.shares: a newcomer's rise inside a household unbalances the man who hired him

relatives.title: Trading Places
relatives.shares: a life is exalted and discarded on the private whim of someone who never explains

relatives.title: The Great Dictator
relatives.shares: an innocent double is punished and elevated for a face he did not choose

films.title: The Burning Soil
films.engine: A peasant's son who thinks himself too good for the land marries into the family that owns the cursed field he knows is sitting on oil. Two women who wanted him — the stepmother he married for the ground and the daughter he courted first — both die of what he did to get it, and he goes home to the brother who never left and the girl who never stopped waiting.

predicaments.situation: a marriage is made for gain not love
predicaments.basis: Having overheard that the count found oil under Devil's Field and taken down the will leaving that field to the widow Helga, Johannes marries her and then spends everything on exploiting the ground she brought him.

predicaments.situation: love is feigned to get something else
predicaments.basis: Johannes tells Helga she is the one he loves only after learning what she will inherit, and later admits to Gerda that he never loved either woman and acted from ambition alone.

predicaments.situation: one lover is set aside for another
predicaments.basis: Johannes courts the count's daughter Gerda while secretary at the castle, then drops her for her stepmother the moment the will is dictated; Gerda spitefully engages herself to a baron and still hopes to win him back.

predicaments.situation: revenge on the guilty destroys the avenger
predicaments.basis: Told to her face that he never loved her, Gerda sets fire to the derrick on Devil's Field and is killed in the explosion it causes.

predicaments.situation: one sibling leaves home the other remains
predicaments.basis: Old Rog leaves two sons: Peter stays bound to the family farm and eventually buys the cursed field himself, while Johannes goes to the castle and the city, and only returns once everything is lost.

relatives.title: There Will Be Blood
relatives.shares: a man's certainty about what lies under a piece of ground consumes every relationship he has

relatives.title: Wuthering Heights
relatives.shares: a marriage made for property poisons everyone who loved either party

relatives.title: Rocco and His Brothers
relatives.shares: one brother abandons the family land for ambition while another holds it, and a woman pays for the difference

relatives.title: Sunrise
relatives.shares: a man's greed sets one woman aside for another and nearly drowns the marriage

relatives.title: Giant
relatives.shares: oil found under inherited land rearranges a family's loyalties and leaves the discoverer alone

films.title: The Best of Enemies
films.engine: A British officer and the Italian officer who captures him keep changing places in the desert — prisoner, captor, prisoner again — until the war between them is mostly a running argument between two men who cannot get away from each other. Each act of leniency is read by the other as a trick, and by the time local villagers have taken both sides' weapons and boots and sent them off, the only thing either has actually won is the other's respect.

predicaments.situation: enemies thrown together come to respect each other
predicaments.basis: Richardson and Blasi begin by irritating each other across an interrogation, get properly acquainted only while surrounded in an abandoned village, and end with Richardson having his men present arms to the recaptured Italians at a railway station.

predicaments.situation: an act of mercy is answered with attack
predicaments.basis: Blasi deliberately lets Richardson and his pilot escape so they will report his unit as not worth attacking, and Richardson is promptly ordered to bring his motorized squadron and round Blasi's men up.

predicaments.situation: an order overrides a private understanding
predicaments.basis: What passed between the two men in the desert counts for nothing against Richardson's orders and Blasi's rallying point, and Blasi surrenders at the fort convinced he has been personally betrayed.

predicaments.situation: captor becomes captive then captor again
predicaments.basis: Richardson is taken by Blasi's detachment, Blasi surrenders to Richardson's armored cars, slips away, is marched as a prisoner of war across the desert, walks free at a road sign, and is recaptured when the convoy brings news the Italians have lost.

predicaments.situation: outsiders strip both sides equally
predicaments.basis: The village headman who claims to back the Allies surrounds them all, and the natives take the weapons and boots of British and Italians alike before letting them go to take their war elsewhere.

relatives.title: La Grande Illusion
relatives.shares: officers on opposite sides recognise each other more than they recognise their own commands

relatives.title: Hell in the Pacific
relatives.shares: two enemies stranded with only each other work out what they actually owe one another

relatives.title: Merry Christmas Mr. Lawrence
relatives.shares: captor and captive keep trading the upper hand until respect outlasts the war

relatives.title: Ice Cold in Alex
relatives.shares: a desert crossing turns an enemy into the one person you cannot hand over

relatives.title: No Man's Land
relatives.shares: outsiders and orders make the two men in the hole more like each other than like their armies

films.title: It Happened in the Park
films.engine: Separate strangers pass a single day in the same park, and the episodes given turn on the same move: someone hands their feelings to another person who intends to use them. A group of nannies panics that one of their own has thrown herself off a wall over a soldier's mockery, and a schoolgirl sets out to trap a teacher with a kiss and cannot go through with it once she has heard him talk.

predicaments.situation: a lover's mockery is answered with threatened self-harm
predicaments.basis: Lidia has already attempted suicide over a soldier, Marietta says she would kill herself if a man made fun of her, and when the Neapolitan soldier turns from her to a Swedish nanny she vanishes and her friends search the cliff for her body.

predicaments.situation: love is feigned to get something else
predicaments.basis: Anna Maria is sent to meet the Greek teacher at a fountain and kiss him suddenly, purely so her classmates can photograph it and force a passing grade out of him.

predicaments.situation: pity disarms a plot against someone
predicaments.basis: The teacher tells her he must give up teaching at the end of the year because he is going blind, and she embraces him while covering his face so the blackmail photograph will be useless.

relatives.title: The Blue Angel
relatives.shares: a teacher's dignity is placed in the hands of a young woman who did not ask for it

relatives.title: Notorious
relatives.shares: affection performed on assignment stops being possible to perform

relatives.title: Cléo from 5 to 7
relatives.shares: a single day in a city where strangers' small encounters decide someone's state of mind

relatives.title: Wild Tales
relatives.shares: unconnected stories held together by one recurring move between people rather than by plot

films.title: Adua and Her Friends
films.engine: Four women whose brothel has been closed by law pool their savings into a restaurant, and discover they cannot hold the licence for it themselves; a former client takes it in his name and charges rent they can only earn by going back to the trade the restaurant was meant to replace. When they refuse him, he does not evict them — he tells the police and the papers who they used to be, which turns out to be the only thing that can take the new life away.

predicaments.situation: people are barred from the life they earned
predicaments.basis: Their application for a restaurant permit is refused on the grounds of their history as prostitutes, after they have already spent two million lire each and rebuilt the building.

predicaments.situation: a new life is held in another's name
predicaments.basis: Ercoli buys the building and obtains the permit in his own name, so the restaurant the four women run and live off is legally his.

roles.dependent: Adua and the other three women

predicaments.situation: help given once is claimed back as ownership
predicaments.basis: Having got them their permit, Ercoli demands a million lire a month and then an ultimatum: resume prostitution to pay him, or be out in twenty-four hours.

predicaments.situation: a hidden past is exposed to destroy someone
predicaments.basis: Humiliated when Adua refuses to pay, Ercoli has the four arrested for prostitution; their photographs run in the newspapers and the respectable lives they had built — Marilina's son with her, Milly's engagement — collapse.

predicaments.situation: a woman is replaced by a younger one
predicaments.basis: Adua, who swore she would never end as a worn-out old prostitute, is back on the street in the rain and passed over for a younger woman.

relatives.title: Street of Shame
relatives.shares: women in a brothel about to be closed by law, each trying to buy an ordinary life with what the trade pays

relatives.title: Nights of Cabiria
relatives.shares: savings hoarded toward respectability taken by the man she trusted, returning her to the road

relatives.title: Sisters of the Gion
relatives.shares: women try to work the trade on their own terms and are broken by the men who bankroll them

relatives.title: The Insect Woman
relatives.shares: a woman climbs out of the trade and is cycled back into it

relatives.title: Vivre sa vie
relatives.shares: a woman's living is held by a man who can revoke it

films.title: The Young One
films.engine: A teenage girl is left alone with the man who kept the island with her grandfather, and his decision to take her in hand becomes taking her. At the same time a musician hiding on the island is being hunted for a rape he did not commit, so the film sets a presumed rapist beside an actual one and watches everybody decide guilt by what they already believe about a man.

predicaments.situation: a guardian takes the child he should protect
predicaments.basis: Miller, who plans to send Evvie to school and the church after her grandfather's death, first has her wash and brush her hair, then buys her a dress and heels, and finally rapes her while Traver plays clarinet in the next cabin.

predicaments.situation: the innocent is presumed guilty by all
predicaments.basis: Traver fled a lynch mob after a white woman accused him of rape; on the island Miller and Jackson hunt him on the same assumption, and only the Reverend, who knows the accuser is a drunk who once falsely accused a white man, believes his denial.

predicaments.situation: a man saves the one he despised
predicaments.basis: Miller, who shot four holes in Traver's boat and tracked him through the woods, ends by handing him oars for crutches, carrying his motor to the water, and running Jackson off the island.

predicaments.situation: a witness is asked to shield the wrongdoer
predicaments.basis: Miller admits the rape to Reverend Fleetwood, defends it, asks not to be reported, and offers to marry Evvie in exchange for silence.

predicaments.situation: an outsider offers to take a child away
predicaments.basis: The Reverend arrives to bury Pee-Wee and to take Evvie to a children's home on the mainland, over Miller's earlier changes of mind about letting her leave.

relatives.title: The Night of the Hunter
relatives.shares: children left in the care of an adult whose protection is appetite

relatives.title: Mouchette
relatives.shares: a girl with nobody to protect her, taken by a man in her own small orbit

relatives.title: To Kill a Mockingbird
relatives.shares: a black man hunted on a white woman's accusation that one outsider knows to be false

relatives.title: The Hunt
relatives.shares: a community's certainty of guilt running far ahead of any evidence

relatives.title: In the Heat of the Night
relatives.shares: two men on opposite sides of a racial line forced into a working truce during a manhunt

films.title: Children of Hiroshima
films.engine: A teacher returns to the city where her parents and sister were killed and works through the people she knew there one at a time, finding each still being taken apart by a day years past. The one repair available to her — taking home a disfigured beggar and his orphaned grandson — is blocked first by the old man's refusal and then by the boy's loyalty to him, until the old man decides the only way to hand the boy over is to stop existing.

predicaments.situation: someone returns to count the missing
predicaments.basis: Takako crosses from her island to Hiroshima on a summer holiday, visits her family's graves and then her former kindergarten pupils and colleagues, finding one father dead of radiation illness, one child dying in a church, one colleague made sterile.

predicaments.situation: an outsider offers to take a child away
predicaments.basis: Takako offers to take Iwakichi and his grandson Tarō back to her island, and later returns to ask again for the boy alone.

predicaments.situation: an offer of rescue is refused
predicaments.basis: Iwakichi, once a servant of Takako's parents and now a burned, half-blind beggar in a shack, runs away rather than accept her offer to take him in.

predicaments.situation: a child refuses to leave his only kin
predicaments.basis: Once the neighbour has talked Iwakichi into letting Tarō go, Tarō himself will not leave his grandfather.

predicaments.situation: an old man dies to release a child
predicaments.basis: On Takako's last evening Iwakichi feeds Tarō, gives him new shoes, sends him off with a letter, and sets his shack alight; he is badly burned and dies, and the boy leaves with Takako carrying his ashes.

relatives.title: Grave of the Fireflies
relatives.shares: children orphaned by bombing, and an offer of care refused out of pride

relatives.title: Black Rain
relatives.shares: survivors of a bombing still dying of it years later, one by one

relatives.title: The Ballad of Narayama
relatives.shares: an old person arranging their own removal so the young are unburdened

relatives.title: Germany Year Zero
relatives.shares: a child in a ruined city carrying an adult's decision

relatives.title: Nobody Knows
relatives.shares: a child who will not be separated from the only family he has

films.title: The Great War
films.engine: Two men who believe in nothing and want only to come out of the war intact — one of them having swindled the other the day they met — drift into friendship and then into the errand the army hands to the two soldiers it rates lowest. Taken prisoner and ready to trade what they know for their lives, they change their minds only because the officer buying it treats them with contempt, and nobody on their own side ever learns they did not run.

predicaments.situation: a cheat becomes the friend of the cheated
predicaments.basis: Oreste takes Giovanni's money on a false promise to get him out of conscription; they meet again on the train to the front, and after Giovanni's initial fury they become inseparable.

predicaments.situation: the least valued are sent to die first
predicaments.basis: The day after Caporetto the two are made relay runners — the most dangerous job going — precisely because they are judged the least efficient men in the unit.

predicaments.situation: a coward chooses death over one more insult
predicaments.basis: Having let slip that they know the plan for the counterattack on the Piave and decided to sell it, they are stung by the Austrian officer's arrogance and his joke about Italians; Giovanni insults him, Oreste shouts that he knows nothing, and both are shot.

predicaments.situation: a sacrifice is made with no one watching
predicaments.basis: The position is retaken and the war moves on; their own captain, who never learns what they refused to say, remarks on the two who ran off.

relatives.title: Paths of Glory
relatives.shares: the men an army rates lowest are the ones it spends

relatives.title: Midnight Cowboy
relatives.shares: a hustler and the man he swindled become each other's only company

relatives.title: La Grande Illusion
relatives.shares: a prisoner's dignity decided by how the enemy officer across the table speaks to him

relatives.title: Ballad of a Soldier
relatives.shares: an ordinary soldier's decency that the war never records

films.title: Stalag 17
films.engine: Two men are shot escaping a prisoner-of-war barracks and the men left behind need to know who told the Germans. They fix on the one they already dislike — the trader who deals openly with the guards and turns his own side's boredom into profit — and beat him for it, while the actual informer carries on as the barracks security officer they trust with their escapes.

predicaments.situation: the innocent is presumed guilty by all
predicaments.basis: Sefton's bartering with the guards and his day with the Russian women make the barracks certain he sold Manfredi and Johnson and then the radio; they beat him, and again blame him when Dunbar is arrested.

roles.accusing: Hoffy and the men of Barracks 4

predicaments.situation: the one entrusted with safety is the danger
predicaments.basis: Price, the barracks security officer who vets escapes and is set to guard Sefton, is the German plant, passing messages through the hollow black queen and the looped light cord.

predicaments.situation: a man saves the one he despised
predicaments.basis: Sefton, who holds that Dunbar only got through officers' school on family money and has been needling him since he arrived, is the one who goes back for him and takes him out through the wire.

predicaments.situation: a betrayer is thrown to those he served
predicaments.basis: Once Sefton exposes the messaging system, the prisoners gag Price, tie noisy cans to his leg and push him out into the compound, where the tower lights find him and he is shot by his own side's Germans.

relatives.title: Le Corbeau
relatives.shares: a closed community hunting its informer and settling its certainty on the wrong person

relatives.title: The Ox-Bow Incident
relatives.shares: a group's need for a culprit outrunning any evidence

relatives.title: Infernal Affairs
relatives.shares: the man charged with finding the mole is the mole

relatives.title: Fury
relatives.shares: a crowd beats the man its suspicion has selected

films.title: A Slice of Life
films.engine: Six short encounters, each caught at the point where one person is about to give up something that does not come back — their body, their newborn, their life, a thing they should have said years ago — with a second person standing in the way of it. Mostly the giving-up is interrupted, sometimes by argument and sometimes by pure accident, and the film's interest is in who happens to be standing there.

predicaments.situation: someone is talked out of selling themselves
predicaments.basis: Mara, short of money, tells Vasco she will go to a brothel in the morning; he persuades her instead to live with him on a teacher's wage, poor as that will be.

predicaments.situation: parents cannot go through with abandoning a child
predicaments.basis: A young couple in the Roman suburbs, unable to work because of the new baby, set out to leave it in a church; the mother cannot settle on a place and the father finally changes his mind.

predicaments.situation: two ruined people meet again by chance
predicaments.basis: A man and a woman of fallen nobility, no longer young, find themselves hired as extras in the same moving carriage and, made to mouth conversation take after take, finally say what went unsaid years ago and leave the set together.

predicaments.situation: the one dissuaded saves the dissuader
predicaments.basis: A village priest presses the old woman Zelinda to give up her wish to end a life of exhausting monotony, and in the heat of arguing slips off a cliff; she is the one who hauls him back up.

predicaments.situation: a stranger asked for help takes everything
predicaments.basis: Having won a camera in a promotional game and failed to photograph themselves with its self-timer, the pair ask a passer-by to take the picture, and he poses them and runs off with the camera.

relatives.title: Nights of Cabiria
relatives.shares: a woman on the edge of selling herself, argued toward a different life

relatives.title: Umberto D
relatives.shares: someone resolved to end it, held back at the last moment by another creature's need

relatives.title: L'amore in città
relatives.shares: episodes of ordinary people at the moment they decide whether to give a child up

relatives.title: The Kid
relatives.shares: a newborn left for someone else to find, and the immediate regret

relatives.title: Bicycle Thieves
relatives.shares: the one possession a poor pair have staked everything on, taken by a stranger in the street

films.title: Task Force
films.engine: A flier spends a whole career insisting on a way of fighting that the men above him do not want to hear, and pays for saying it in rank and time. The woman he marries — already widowed once by this same flying — spends those decades waiting for him to come back from somewhere. The war finally settles the argument for him, and he retires to the wife still standing on the dock.

predicaments.situation: one man argues against everyone in authority
predicaments.basis: Scott spends twenty-eight years pressing the case for the aircraft carrier against senior Navy officers and Congress, antagonising powerful people the whole way.

predicaments.situation: a man refuses the easier life offered him
predicaments.basis: After Japan invades Manchuria and his outspokenness has already cost him a promotion, Scott is offered a civilian job selling aircraft in Europe and stays in the Navy.

predicaments.situation: a man marries the widow of a comrade
predicaments.basis: Scott marries Mary Morgan, whose first husband was a fellow flier killed in a crash during a carrier takeoff.

predicaments.situation: a marriage is lived around long absences
predicaments.basis: Hawaii, Annapolis, Midway, Washington, Okinawa — Mary's marriage is arranged around Scott's postings until she is waiting on the dock at his retirement four years after the war.

predicaments.situation: a younger man is protected by an older one
predicaments.basis: Pete Richard, Scott's superior officer and mentor, gives him help and friendship throughout the years his opinions are making him enemies.

relatives.title: The Court-Martial of Billy Mitchell
relatives.shares: one man argues against everyone in authority and is punished for the arguing before he is proved right

relatives.title: The Wind Rises
relatives.shares: a vocation eats the years a marriage was supposed to be lived in

relatives.title: The Best Years of Our Lives
relatives.shares: a marriage lived around absence, judged at the moment of return

relatives.title: Twelve O'Clock High
relatives.shares: a man's insistence on how the fighting should be done sets him against the people who outrank him

relatives.title: Sunshine
relatives.shares: a career spent refusing the easier life offered at every turn

films.title: Come Fill the Cup
films.engine: A reporter drinks himself out of his job and out of the woman he loves, and is pulled back by a man who has been exactly where he is. When she marries someone else, the way he keeps his own footing is to take her husband in and do for him what was done for him — including standing between the man and the people trying to kill him.

predicaments.situation: a man ruined by drink is taken in
predicaments.basis: Charley Dolan, an ex-alcoholic, gives the fired and homeless Lew Marsh a room and a construction job; Lew later gives Boyd Copeland the same room.

predicaments.situation: a rescued man becomes the rescuer of another
predicaments.basis: Months sober and useful to other drinkers, Lew is asked by his employer Ives to do for his nephew Boyd what Charley did for Lew.

predicaments.situation: a man loves a woman married to another
predicaments.basis: Lew lost Paula Arnold while drinking and she married Boyd; he brings her back to the paper secretly hoping she will love him again.

predicaments.situation: a man rescues his own replacement in love
predicaments.basis: Lew houses Boyd, covers his affair with the singer Maria, and fights off the gangster Garr beside him, then hands Paula back to him.

predicaments.situation: a bystander dies in another man's place
predicaments.basis: Garr rigs a car to kill Boyd and kills Charley by mistake, and Boyd is left holding the death as his own doing.

relatives.title: Drunken Angel
relatives.shares: a man who knows the illness from inside takes charge of another man's ruin and cannot control what it costs

relatives.title: The Lost Weekend
relatives.shares: a writer's drinking dismantles the work and the woman, and someone else has to hold the line

relatives.title: Days of Wine and Roses
relatives.shares: one of a pair gets sober and the other keeps drinking, and the marriage hangs on it

relatives.title: The Apartment
relatives.shares: a man ends up caring for the woman his rival is treating badly, and has to decide what to do about it

relatives.title: Ikiru
relatives.shares: a man who has wasted his time spends what remains being useful to people in the same condition

films.title: Close to My Heart
films.engine: A childless couple move toward taking in an abandoned baby, and the husband — unwilling to love a child whose people he cannot account for — goes looking for where the boy came from. His digging turns up exactly the parentage that makes officials refuse the boy, and he has to talk his way back past the case he himself built.

predicaments.situation: a childless couple seeks a child to raise
predicaments.basis: Brad and Midge Sheridan cannot have children and pursue Danny, a foundling left at a police station and made a ward of the juvenile court.

predicaments.situation: a child's future hangs on strangers' judgement
predicaments.basis: Mrs. Morrow's agency and the juvenile court decide whether Danny goes to the Sheridans, warn them off, and finally take him away from them.

predicaments.situation: a man digs into a past best unknown
predicaments.basis: Brad traces Danny's mother Martha through Arlene, a boarding house and a ring, and publishes a photograph of the man who fathered him.

predicaments.situation: a child is judged by his parentage
predicaments.basis: Danny goes unwanted as a foundling, and once Mrs. Morrow recognises Hewitt as a man imprisoned for murder the adoption is stopped outright.

predicaments.situation: a parent refuses the child he never met
predicaments.basis: Told at San Quentin that he has a son and that Martha died bearing him, Hewitt answers bitterly that there was no place in his life for a child.

relatives.title: Like Father, Like Son
relatives.shares: whether a child belongs to the people raising him or to the blood he came from, decided by adults arguing over him

relatives.title: Shoplifters
relatives.shares: a child's future settled by officials weighing background against the people who actually want him

relatives.title: Philomena
relatives.shares: a journalist digs up the origins of a child and the digging becomes the story he is writing

relatives.title: Secrets & Lies
relatives.shares: a search into who bore a child forces the truth on people who arranged their lives around not knowing

relatives.title: Nobody Knows
relatives.shares: an abandoned child whose existence sits outside every official record

films.title: Mara Maru
films.engine: A salvage diver, suspected of murdering his own partner, is handed the chance to bring up a fortune he himself lost during the war, and keeps choosing it over the woman begging him to go home and live an ordinary life. What he raises turns out to be an object other men will die to see put back rather than sold, and the last person who wants it from him is the one who helped him find it.

predicaments.situation: a man is suspected of a friend's murder
predicaments.basis: Mason is arrested for Callahan's killing after their public quarrel and is only cleared when Ranier claims to have witnessed it.

predicaments.situation: a woman loves the man her husband envied
predicaments.basis: Stella married Callahan but stayed in love with Mason, and Callahan's jealousy over their earlier relationship is what set the killing in motion.

predicaments.situation: a chosen prize is weighed against a person
predicaments.basis: Stella twice begs Mason to abandon the sunken diamonds and return with her to a normal life, and he twice picks the treasure.

predicaments.situation: a man refuses the easier life offered him
predicaments.basis: Even after learning Benedict means to kill him once the box is up, Mason stays with the expedition rather than take Stella's offer of the United States.

predicaments.situation: a friendship is built on a hidden purpose
predicaments.basis: Ranier is hired by Mason as protection while working with Benedict all along, and Stella first appears to be playing both sides.

predicaments.situation: what one man sells another holds sacred
predicaments.basis: The salvaged box holds a jewelled crucifix from a Manila cathedral; Manuelo and Ortega want it returned to the church and Mason beats Manuelo over it.

relatives.title: The Treasure of the Sierra Madre
relatives.shares: partners in a hunt for buried wealth turn on each other as the prize comes up

relatives.title: Ugetsu
relatives.shares: a man's pursuit of gain set against the woman asking him to come home, and the answer arriving too late

relatives.title: The Maltese Falcon
relatives.shares: a partner's murder, a coveted object, and every ally secretly working for someone else

relatives.title: Aguirre, the Wrath of God
relatives.shares: greed carried through jungle at the cost of everyone who came along

relatives.title: The Mission
relatives.shares: a man's violence measured against what other people hold sacred, and paid for by giving the thing back

films.title: Cops and Robbers
films.engine: A small-time swindler and the policeman who must catch him within three months or lose his job end up eating at each other's tables, each concealing his disgrace from his own family. When they finally recognise each other, the friendship has gone far enough that the thief decides to walk himself to prison to save the man hunting him — and the policeman ends up looking after the thief's family in his absence.

predicaments.situation: a pursuer becomes the friend of his quarry
predicaments.basis: Sergeant Bottoni, hunting Esposito in plain clothes, is drawn into the Esposito household, the two families become friends and a romance starts between their relatives.

predicaments.situation: a friendship is built on a hidden purpose
predicaments.basis: Bottoni conceals that he is a policeman, courting Esposito's family with favours and food only so that Esposito will eventually walk in.

predicaments.situation: a man hides his ruin from his family
predicaments.basis: Bottoni keeps his suspension and the threat to his job from his own household, while Esposito's family does not know what he really does for money.

predicaments.situation: one man accepts punishment to save another
predicaments.basis: Once he understands that Bottoni will lose his job otherwise, Esposito insists on being taken in, over the sergeant's own reluctance.

predicaments.situation: one man keeps another's family in his absence
predicaments.basis: With the arrest disguised as a business trip and a send-off at the station, Bottoni takes on the care of the Esposito family while Esposito is inside.

relatives.title: Bicycle Thieves
relatives.shares: a man stealing to keep a family fed, and the man on the other side of it seeing the family

relatives.title: Les Misérables
relatives.shares: a pursuer and his quarry bound to each other until the hunt turns into something neither can carry out

relatives.title: Catch Me If You Can
relatives.shares: the man chasing and the man running become the only company each has

relatives.title: The Bicycle Thief of Rome's cousin, Big Deal on Madonna Street
relatives.shares: petty crooks whose schemes are really an argument with poverty, played for comedy

relatives.title: Tokyo Story's neighbour, Good Morning
