relatives.shares: two households whose small deceptions of each other decide what the families think they share

films.title: I Know Where I'm Going!
films.engine: A young woman travelling to marry a very rich man much older than she is gets stopped by weather one island short of the wedding, among people who think nothing of what she is marrying for. The delay puts her beside a man who owns the island her fiancé is only renting, and she spends the storm trying to get across the water rather than admit what has happened to her.

predicaments.situation: a promise of marriage collides with new love
predicaments.basis: Joan is on her way to marry Sir Robert Bellinger when the gale strands her with Torquil MacNeil and she is torn between her plans and him.

predicaments.situation: a traveller is stranded among unfamiliar people
predicaments.basis: Weather holds Joan on Mull among boatmen, a falconer and impoverished gentry whose values are nothing like the ones she arrived with.

predicaments.situation: a chosen prize is weighed against a person
predicaments.basis: Joan has arranged her life around marrying one of the wealthiest men in England, and the islanders' talk plus the ceilidh put that beside Torquil, who has an island and no money.

predicaments.situation: a person flees the one they want
predicaments.basis: Joan pays Kenny twenty pounds to run the crossing in a full gale, and Catriona tells Torquil plainly that she is running from him.

predicaments.situation: an ancestor's crime binds a living descendant
predicaments.basis: Torquil will not enter Moy Castle because a woman his forebear drowned with her lover cursed every laird of Kiloran to be chained to a woman for life.

relatives.title: Local Hero
relatives.shares: a visitor arrives on a coast to complete a rich man's transaction and is undone by the delay and the people in it

relatives.title: It Happened One Night
relatives.shares: a woman travelling toward a wealthy fiancé falls for the man she is stuck with on the way

relatives.title: Brief Encounter
relatives.shares: an attachment formed inside a delay, weighed against a life already arranged

relatives.title: Late Spring
relatives.shares: a marriage arranged for good practical reasons set against what the person actually wants

relatives.title: The Quiet Man
relatives.shares: an outsider held by a community whose customs and old grievances decide what love is allowed

films.title: Foundry Town
films.engine: A girl in her last year of junior high wants to go on to full-time high school, and watches the household stop being able to afford her: her father is hurt, then laid off, then too proud and too old-handed to hold the work he is offered, and her mother goes to work in a bar. The film is about what she does with the future that has been quietly withdrawn — hiding the family's state from the classmates who know, walking away from school entirely, and finally deciding which kind of adult she is going to become instead.

predicaments.situation: a child carries the household the parent cannot
predicaments.basis: Jun takes shifts at a pachinko parlour for living money and school fees while her father Tatsugoro drinks and gambles away the benefits won for him, and her younger brother Takayuki tries to raise pigeons to sell.

predicaments.situation: help is refused as humiliation
predicaments.basis: Katsumi wins Tatsugoro several months of injury benefit through the union, and Tatsugoro, ashamed of being "indebted to the Reds", spends every yen of it on alcohol and motorcycle racing.

predicaments.situation: a child hides home from friends
predicaments.basis: Jun skips the school-trip meeting point rather than face Nobuko, whose father found her father the foundry job he has just secretly quit, and spends the day alone on the riverbank and at the gates of the high school she wanted.

predicaments.situation: a child sees a parent unmasked
predicaments.basis: Jun looks into the pub where her mother Tomi now works and sees her flirting with the male customers, after which she stops going to school altogether.

predicaments.situation: someone returns home to find it gone
predicaments.basis: Sankichi gets off the repatriation train at Omiya and comes back to Kawaguchi for his Japanese mother, only to find her diner shut and herself gone to marry someone else.

relatives.title: Bicycle Thieves
relatives.shares: a child watching a parent's competence and authority come apart under want

relatives.title: Rosetta
relatives.shares: a girl holding a household together on scraps of work while a parent drinks

relatives.title: The 400 Blows
relatives.shares: a child sees a parent unmasked and stops going to school

relatives.title: Tokyo Chorus
relatives.shares: a father's lost job silently reorganizes what his children are allowed to want

relatives.title: Nobody Knows
relatives.shares: children keeping the true state of home hidden from everyone outside it

films.title: Pardon My Past
films.engine: A discharged soldier on his way to start a mink farm is grabbed off the street because he has another man's face, and is dropped into that man's family — the wife he walked out on, the daughter he is suing to keep from her, the uncle steering the whole quarrel. Playing the man, he turns out to be better at the man's life than the man is, and the mess he tidies up is a marriage that a third party has been keeping broken on purpose.

predicaments.situation: a man is mistaken for another
predicaments.basis: Eddie York is taken for the playboy Francis Pemberton by a bookie's thug at a tailor's, and then by the entire Pemberton household, who have not seen Francis in two years.

predicaments.situation: an impostor lives another's life better
predicaments.basis: Standing in as Francis, Eddie is generous and decisive where Francis was evasive and timid, tells Uncle Wills to let Mary see Stephanie freely, and impresses the wife and grandfather who had given the real man up.

predicaments.situation: one man is made to answer for another
predicaments.basis: Jim Arnold's thug holds Eddie at gunpoint and takes his $3,000 against Francis Pemberton's $12,000 gambling debt, refusing every explanation that he has the wrong man.

predicaments.situation: a child is fought over by two parents
predicaments.basis: Francis is suing for sole custody of Stephanie and trying to have Mary declared an unfit mother, with half his fortune riding on the outcome.

predicaments.situation: word between two is intercepted by a third
predicaments.basis: Uncle Wills has destroyed every letter Mary sent to Francis in Mexico, and Eddie tricks him into confessing it in front of Francis, who throws him out and goes back to his wife.

predicaments.situation: one of the trusted works against them
predicaments.basis: Wills, the family man with the safe combination, engineers the custody suit, has Mary arrested for kidnapping her own daughter, and tries to get Francis committed to a psychiatric ward.

relatives.title: The Return of Martin Guerre
relatives.shares: a stranger fills a missing man's place in a family and fills it better

relatives.title: Kagemusha
relatives.shares: a double grows into the role until he outgrows the man he stands for

relatives.title: Dave
relatives.shares: an impostor does the absent man's job with a decency the man never had

relatives.title: The Prince and the Pauper
relatives.shares: two identical men and a household that cannot tell which one it has

relatives.title: Kramer vs. Kramer
relatives.shares: a child fought over by two parents with a legal machine sharpening the fight

films.title: Hangmen Also Die!
films.engine: A doctor shoots the occupation's governor and vanishes into a stranger's apartment; the occupiers answer by seizing four hundred citizens and shooting them in batches until someone gives him up. The film is about the daughter of one of those hostages, who can buy her father back with a name she happens to know, and about a whole city quietly agreeing to swear the same lie so that she does not have to.

predicaments.situation: many are held to force one to surrender
predicaments.basis: Unable to find Heydrich's assassin, the Nazi authorities take four hundred Czech men hostage and execute them forty at a time until the killer gives himself up or is denounced.

predicaments.situation: a child must betray to save a parent
predicaments.basis: Mascha knows Svoboda is the assassin and her father Professor Novotny is among the hostages; she goes to Gestapo headquarters to denounce him and cannot make herself do it.

predicaments.situation: a household shelters a stranger at mortal risk
predicaments.basis: Mascha misdirects the soldiers hunting Svoboda and takes him in; her father guesses at once who he is and hides him anyway, and is taken hostage and shot.

predicaments.situation: one of the trusted works against them
predicaments.basis: Emil Czaka sits in the resistance's meetings and knows its leaders while working as a German fifth-columnist, and his information gets most of the cell killed or arrested.

predicaments.situation: one man is made to answer for another
predicaments.basis: The resistance manufactures testimony from Mascha and many others to pin Heydrich's assassination, and later Inspector Gruber's murder, on Czaka, and the Gestapo shoot him for it.

predicaments.situation: two must pretend to be lovers
predicaments.basis: Svoboda and Mascha stage conversations for the bugged apartment so the Gestapo will read their contact as an affair behind her fiancé Jan's back rather than as conspiracy.

relatives.title: The Battle of Algiers
relatives.shares: an occupier squeezing a whole population to make it surrender the men in its middle

relatives.title: Army of Shadows
relatives.shares: an underground deciding who among its own has to be killed to protect the rest

relatives.title: Rome, Open City
relatives.shares: an ordinary household hiding a hunted man and paying for it with a life

relatives.title: Sophie's Choice
relatives.shares: a person handed the arithmetic of whose life to buy and whose to give up

relatives.title: Le Silence de la mer
relatives.shares: a father and daughter under one roof holding a line against an occupier in their house
